# hiptest-publisher

**Tag**: testing

## 简介

Provides a command-line tool that generates Java, Python or Ruby code to run the tests.

## 官网

- 主页: https://cucumber.io
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/hiptest-publisher/3.2.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/hiptest-publisher
